title: Akerson Enterprises Recalls Kindred Bravely Bamboo Nursing Hoodies Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The drawcord on the hoodies has small plastic caps that can be swallowed by a nursing baby, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 7,500.

title: Bedshe International Recalls Bedsure Electric Heating Blankets and Pads Due to Fire and Thermal Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The controller for the electric heating blankets and pads can malfunction, posing fire and thermal burn hazards. Units: About 350,000.

title: BeyondMedShop Recalls Vaunn Medical Adult Bed Rails Due to Serious Entrapment and Asphyxia Hazards
summary: When the recalled bed rails are attached to an adult's bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. Units: About 102,000.

title: Crib Bumpers Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Crib Bumper Ban; Suffocation Hazard; Sold by Meiling Hou (Recall Alert)
summary: Infants can suffocate if they roll or move on the crib bumper in a position that obstructs breathing. Padded crib bumpers are banned under federal law. Units: About 125.

title: Epoch Everlasting Play Recalls All Calico Critters Animal Figures and Sets Sold with Bottle and Pacifier Accessories, More than 3.2 Million, Due to Choking Hazard; Two Deaths Reported
summary: The bottle and pacifier accessories pose a choking hazard to children. Units: More than 3.2 Million.

title: Fantasia Trading Recalls Anker Power Banks Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion batteries in the recalled power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 42,000 (In addition, about 620 were sold in Canada).

title: Monoprice Recalls Pure Outdoor Cooking System Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The insulation coating on the stove can ignite during use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,780.

title: Sandoz Recalls Aprepitant Capsules and Lidocaine and Prilocaine Cream Prescription Drugs Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The recalled prescription drugs and products that contain lidocaine must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). title: Vornado Air Recalls Portable SRTH Small Room Tower Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heaters have a miswiring due to a manufacturing error which can cause the tower heater to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,450.

title: YETI Recalls 1.9 Million Soft Coolers and Gear Cases Due to Magnet Ingestion Hazard
summary: The magnet-lined closures can fail and result in detached magnets, posing a risk of serious injury or death if ingested. title: Active Sports Recalls Wakeboard Bindings Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: During use, the binding can partially detach from the binding baseplate at the heel or the external binding mount can crack and detach from the wakeboard, causing the user to lose their balance and fall into the water. Units: 850.

title: DR Power Equipment Recalls PRO XL501 Chipper Shredders Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fin scroll of the chipper shredder can fail, ejecting pieces of metal from the chipper shredder hopper during operation, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 2,100 (In addition, about 27 were sold in Canada and about 3 were sold in Mexico).

title: Helly Hansen Recalls Adult Workwear Sweatshirts and Hoodies Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled clothing fails to meet flammability standards for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 13,900 (In addition, 128,680 were sold in Canada).

title: Multi-Purpose Kids Bike Helmets Recalled Due to Risk of Head Injury; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com; Sold by Ouwoer Direct (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability and impact attenuation requirements of the CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect a child in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 120.

title: Patagonia Recalls Patagonia Infant Capilene Midweight Base Layer Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps in the bodysuit of the recalled base layer sets can detach, posing a choking hazard if mouthed by infants. Units: About 8,000 (In addition, about 217 were sold in Canada).

title: Primark Recalls Children's Bamboo Plates Due to Risk of Lead and Chemical Exposure Hazards
summary: The recalled children's bamboo plates have elevated levels of lead and formaldehyde. Both lead and formaldehyde are toxic if ingested by children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 1,665.

title: Relion Battery Recalls Relion Insight Series Lithium Batteries Due to Thermal Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The batteries can overheat, posing thermal burn and fire hazards. Units: About 7,250 (In addition, about 121 were sold in Canada).

title: Smocked Runway Recalls Classic Whimsy Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled children's pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 7,200.

title: TJX Recalls Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The back of the chair can break or detach from the seat base when a consumer is seated in the chair, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 81,700 (In addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Burnham Commercial Recalls Natural Gas Boilers Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Delayed ignition and/or flame rollout can occur with the boilers, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 185.

title: Kawasaki Motors USA Recalls Engines Sold on Ferris and SCAG Riding Lawn Mowers Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The high-pressure fuel line can get damaged by contact with the fuel pump cover, causing a fuel leak that poses burn and fire hazards. Units: About 33,100.

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Arctic Cat Alterra 600 and Tracker 600 All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ATV's A-arm can separate from the frame and cause loss of steering control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 3,800 (In addition, about 1,200 were sold in Canada) (Arctic Cat and Tracker ATVs have been previously recalled in July 2022).

title: Mockingbird Expands Recall to Include Single Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The lower side of the stroller frame can crack, posing a fall risk to children in the stroller. Units: About 25,390 (149,000 Single-to-Double Strollers were previously recalled in November 2022).

title: Ecoxall Recalls Sodium Hydroxide Caustic Soda Beads and Potassium Hydroxide Flakes Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The products contain sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide which must be in child resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of chemical burns and irritation to the skin and eyes. In addition,

title: Fredericksburg Farms Recalls 10 Ounce Scented Candles with Glass Lids Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Some of the glass lids are too tight causing the jar to break when the lid is forcibly removed, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 6,500.

title: IKEA Recalls Mirrors Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The plastic fittings that attach the mirror to the wall can break, causing the mirror to fall, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,400 (In addition, about 17,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Pfizer Recalls Nurtec ODT Prescription Drugs Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The recalled prescription drugs must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 4.2 million.

title: Polaris Recalls Sportsman All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire and Crash Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: An improperly assembled wiring harness can contact the brake line and/or vehicle frame during use which can result in a loss of the use of the front brakes and/or fire, posing fire and crash hazards. Units: About 80,000 (In addition, about 13,900 were sold in Canada).

title: STIHL Incorporated Recalls Docking Stations Sold with STIHL iMOW Robotic Lawn Mowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The docking station's printed circuit board can short circuit when exposed to moisture, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,700.

title: Sunbeam Heated Blankets Recalled Due to Burn and Fire Hazards; Distributed by Star Elite
summary: The recalled heated blankets can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 43,000 (In addition, about 15,000 were sold in Canada).

title: The Laundress Recalls Fabric Conditioners Due to Chemical Hazard, Including Previously Recalled Units
summary: The fabric conditioners can contain a chemical impurity, ethylene oxide, a carcinogen that can cause adverse health effects if there is significant and direct long-term exposure. Units: About 800,000 (730,000 of the 800,000 were recalled on December 1, 2022). (An additional 13,000 units were sold in

title: Bicycles and Framesets Recalled Due to Crash Hazard; Manufactured by Open Cycle
summary: The rear brake can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 270.

title: Cannondale Recalls Tesoro Neo X Speed Electric Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bicycles do not meet the U.S. safety standard; the hand brakes are configured in accordance with the European safety standard which is reversed from the U.S. safety standard, posing fall and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 75.

title: Carhartt Recalls Men's Work Pants with Hem Adjustment Cords Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Dick's Sporting Goods
summary: An elastic drawstring hem near the ankle of the pants can create an extended loop, posing a trip and fall hazard. Units: About 32,505.

title: Delta Enterprise Corp. Recalls 2-in-1 Outdoor Kids Swings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The swing seat restraint straps can break, posing a fall hazard to young children. Units: About 43,380.

title: Higdon Outdoors Recalls Battery Packs on XS Series Motion Waterfowl Decoys and Replacement Battery Packs Due to Fire and/or Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled waterfowl decoys' lithium-ion battery packs or replacement battery packs can overheat while charging or soon after charging, posing a fire and/or burn hazard. Units: About 45,000 (In addition, about 500 were sold in Canada).

title: JBM International Electric Recalls Adult Bike Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability and labeling and certification requirements of the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 5,300.

title: Jetson Electric Bikes Recalls 42-Volt Rogue Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Due to Fire Hazard; Two Deaths Reported
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 53,000.

title: Lexmark Ventures Recalls Solexio Hair Stylers Due to Electrocution or Shock Hazard
summary: The cord on the hair stylers can detach if the unit is dropped, posing an electrocution or shock hazard to users. Units: About 26,830.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The alternator can fail during operation, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 200 (In addition, about 2 were sold in Canada).
